'''Tamir Cousins-Ali''' is a voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Little is known Cousins-Ali's life, other than he became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where he gained his most notable role as [[Rango]], {{an|Kiawe}}'s father.

==Pokémon roles==
===Animation===
===={{aniseries|PTS}}====
* [[Rango]]
* Glasses {{pkmn|Trainer}} ([[SM013]])

==Other non-Pokémon roles==
